scripts.prebuild: node tools/ensure_nov_grid_for_build.mjs && npm run validate:levy-explainer && npm run validate:levy-authority-chain && npm run validate:app-json
scripts.test:parcel-index: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_build_arapahoe_parcel_levy_index.py" -q && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_situs_lookup_contract.py" -q
scripts.test:ingest: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_ingest_*.py" -q && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_situs_lookup_contract.py" -q
scripts.build:ingest:ship: python3 tools/ingest/build.py --mapping tools/ingest/mappings/arapahoe.json --tag-file "supporting-data/county-mart/Tax Authority Groups and Tax Authorities (CSV)/Tax Authority Groups and Tax Authorities.csv" --parcel-file "supporting-data/county-mart/Main Parcel Table (CSV)/Main Parcel Table.csv" --out-dir public/data --ship --bundled-as-of $(cat tools/county-mart-data-as-of.txt | tr -d '\n')
scripts.build:ingest:douglas: python3 tools/ingest/build.py --mapping tools/ingest/mappings/douglas.json --tag-file supporting-data/douglas/2025-tax-districts-and-mill-levies.pdf --parcel-file supporting-data/douglas/Property_Location.txt --values-file supporting-data/douglas/Property_Values.txt --out-dir supporting-data/_ingest-out/douglas --bundled-as-of $(cat tools/douglas-data-as-of.txt | tr -d '\n') --tax-year 2025 --skip-neighborhood --dola-certifying-county Douglas
scripts.land:douglas: cp supporting-data/_ingest-out/douglas/douglas-pin-to-tag.json supporting-data/_ingest-out/douglas/douglas-levy-stacks-by-tag-id.json supporting-data/_ingest-out/douglas/douglas-situs-to-pins.json public/data/ && rm -rf public/data/douglas-parcel-record-by-pin && cp -R supporting-data/_ingest-out/douglas/douglas-parcel-record-by-pin public/data/
scripts.test:authority-mills-extract: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_extract_authority_mills_by_tax_year.py -q && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_extract_douglas_authority_mills_by_tax_year.py -q
